name: SpareForge
description:
About This Game

Forge your legend

SpareForge is an action RPG for players who miss the old-school online RPGs: real-time combat, a deep job system, loot that keeps you hunting, and friends at your side.

Features

  • 12 jobs– start as a Wanderer, choose a first job (Warrior, Arcanist, Archer, Cleric, Tinker or Rogue), then master a second job: Vanguard, Sorcerer, Ranger, Luminary, Forgemaster or Shadowblade.

  • Two kinds of levels – raise your base level up to 150 and your job level separately, and spend stat points to build your character your way.

  • 82 skills with their own effects and cast times.

  • 20 zones – from the meadows of Verdant Field to frozen passes, sunken ruins, ashen wastes and the Void Sanctum, with two hub towns, field zones and dungeons.

  • Bosses in the fields and dungeons, including Apex bosses with unique loot.

  • Loot in six rarities – gear rolls random affixes, from Crude to Perfect.

  • The forge – refine, repair and reforge your gear for that one perfect line.

  • Cards, pets and mounts – slot monster cards into your gear, let your pet collect loot, and ride a mount across the world.

  • LAN co-op – play together with up to four players on your home network. Single-player works just as well.

  • 12 interface languages – English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Polish, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese.

Development status

SpareForge is in active development and still being balanced and polished. Your feedback helps shape the game.
short_desc: An action RPG in the spirit of the classic online RPGs. Pick a class, master a second job, explore 20 zones, hunt bosses and chase the perfect roll on your gear – alone or with up to four players in LAN co-op.
